name: After § 22
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on digitalisation, artificial intelligence and algorithmic management in the workplace – shaping the future of work
part_text: A. whereas the digital transition, driven by digitalisation, automation and artificial intelligence (AI), is profoundly reshaping labour markets, leading to the disappearance of some jobs and the emergence of new ones, and is changing the nature of tasks in the existing ones, therefore requiring continuous adaptation by businesses and workers, including in various sectors, where these changes affect how works are created, distributed, and safeguarded;
